season.evidence: Only one recorded Mongo Ridge ascent (July); web results show early-to-mid July parties (2021, 2022, 2024) and nothing contradicting the stored Jul-Aug window.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 5 Jul 2021 logged Mongo Ridge, summited, but the track is a fragment near the Access basin, 6.3 km from the summit pin; not complete.

season.evidence: Logged NW face and North Buttress ascents in Jul and Aug; whole-peak histogram Jul 15, Aug 8; web search finds July and August windows.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 15 Jul 2023 summit, no logged route, track runs from Big Beaver to Luna Col only, not complete.
Traverse from East Fury (the Ridge Traverse route), partial from Luna Col.

season.evidence: Logged ascents in Jul and Aug; web results show July and early-August outings; stored Jul-Sep kept in text, Aug clearest.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 2 Aug 2025: logged as a traverse from East Fury, summit 4 m from our pin, but the track starts and ends at Luna Col (about 19 km from the Ross Dam pin), so it fails the complete/one-way test; strong identity, partial track.

facts.text: The third tower has a long chimney, around 170 ft, on its west side; in early August one soloist climbed it on the return and rappelled each tower.

notes: The 'West Ridge / Northwest Route' row has face text saying it is the connecting ridge to East Fury, but its overview is the 1958 first ascent from the west (Challenger Glacier); the face field looks wrong. The Mongo Ridge id contains 'east' but it is the SW buttress of West Fury. No track from a trailhead reaches the summit for any of these; 2929064 would be a good Ridge Traverse summit-day track if partial tracks are allowed.
